prompt: Which is the most recent film to dominate the British Academy Film Awards by winning more than seven awards while also having the most total wins and nominations in its award year?
answer:
The most recent such film is **_The Killing Fields_ (1984)**. At the **38th British Academy Film Awards in 1985**, it led the field with **eight wins from 13 nominations**—the most wins and nominations of that award year.  

It remains the latest film to win more than seven BAFTAs; **_Oppenheimer_** won seven in 2024, while the all-time record is **nine**, held by _Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid_ (1971).
